events.text: So the thing about our product is that users absolutely hate configuring things. Nobody wants settings.
The core flow has to work with zero setup, out of the box.
It's honestly ten times faster than anything out there.
Okay, fair — ten times faster at first-run setup specifically. You're drafting in under a minute, where the incumbents take ten just to onboard you.
The onboarding is a single screen. You open it, you talk, it writes. That is the entire pitch.
We keep the interface to one input and one document. Nothing else competes for your attention.
And for power users we're going to let them customize every single part of the pipeline.
Right — customization stays buried unless you go digging for it. The default path never shows you a single setting.
